audience: home improvement contractors who track projects and sales meetings in Builder Prime

useCases.title: Review recent projects
useCases.text: List recently changed projects and open one to check its customer, status and value. Project lists cover changes within the past year, with additional pages available.

useCases.title: Check upcoming sales meetings
useCases.text: List meetings in a chosen date range, open a meeting for details and look up employees to identify attendees.

useCases.title: Update a project after reviewing its details
useCases.text: Read a project, then change only the fields you specify, such as its status. Account status names must match exactly; updates execute immediately and may trigger workflows.

useCases.title: Book a meeting for an existing opportunity
useCases.text: Look up meeting types and employees, then create a meeting for an existing client opportunity. Check dates, timezone, attendee and type first; vendor notifications may occur.
